target:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one transparent PNG character sprite for an original interactive seek-and-find game, NOT a scene or character sheet.
Primary request: a small friendly adult woman named Wanda, standing upright in a simple full-body FRONT view, arms down beside her torso, two clearly separated legs. Dark brown bob haircut, warm yellowish light tan skin, a RED AND WHITE HORIZONTAL STRIPED SWEATER, medium blue trousers, dark simple shoes. Make the red/white stripes broad and regular: four bold red stripes alternating with four clear white stripes across the whole torso, enough to remain distinct when the whole person is rendered only 52 pixels tall. No hat, no glasses, no scarf, no props.
Style/medium: charming crisp flat illustrated picture-puzzle clip art, dark clean outlines and flat bright colors, simple facial details; no gradients, realistic lighting, textures or shadows. Narrow full-body silhouette approximately width 0.35 times height; distinguish the bob hair from the dark outline.
Composition/framing: a single centered full-body figure, fully visible feet and hair, portrait image 1024x1536 with generous genuinely TRANSPARENT padding. The character fills about 85% of the image height, but do not crop her. Keep both arms close to sides and symmetric.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background and no floor or cast shadow; isolated sprite only. Original fictional character, no commercial character, no logo, no text, no watermark. Sweater stripes must be exactly red and white and horizontal; trousers exactly blue. Do not include other people or scenery.

initialBackgrounds.festival:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE square original seek-and-find game background, 1024x1024, filling the whole image; no UI, no panel divisions or frame.
Style/medium: charming crisp illustrated picture-puzzle crowd, flat bright colors, clean dark outlines, small readable faces, modest simple shading. No photographs or 3D render. Elevated front-ish orthographic viewpoint: we see upright people's full bodies and some ground, but their apparent sizes stay uniform throughout the scene. Coherent, lively, colorful, detailed.
Critical scale/composition: 70–100 diverse people distributed densely across the entire scene with interesting recognizable objects. ALL adults roughly 90–110 pixels tall in this 1024 square, including foreground and background people; this becomes around45–55px tall on a512px game canvas. Do not put giant close-up foreground characters, tiny horizon figures, a central hero, enormous head, or a dramatic perspective vanishing point. Arrange many people and objects in staggered rows with paths between them, some overlap, busy but readable. Full-height people remain the main scene texture, no big empty sky.
Distractors: many ordinary red tops, white tops, blue trousers, dark bob hair, warm skin colors, and a few shirts with BLUE-WHITE, GREEN-WHITE or ORANGE stripes. Include varied ages, skin tones and genders. NEVER include anyone wearing a red-and-white horizontally striped sweater with blue trousers: that exact female target is absent. No commercial or copyrighted characters, no readable text, signs with lettering, logos or watermarks.
Scene/backdrop: a bustling outdoor town festival in a cheerful plaza, pennant strings, little music and craft booths, people dancing, small food stalls, balloons and benches. Crowd figures dominate, with many tiny humorous interactions and scattered red/white/blue clothing distractors. Keep overhead pennants away from faces; no large stage hiding the crowd.
